# U.S. House of Representatives

> The official website of the U.S. House of Representatives providing live legislative tracking, committee hearings, floor activity, and congressional records.

House.gov serves as the primary digital hub for the legislative branch, offering real-time access to floor proceedings, committee activities, and legislative information. The site integrates multiple resources including live streaming, voting records, and comprehensive bill tracking through Congress.gov and GPO govinfo.

## Key Topics

- Congressional Hearings
- Committee Meetings
- House Floor Activity
- Legislative Tracking
- Voting Records
- Committee Rules
- Bill Information
- Live Streaming
- Witness Testimony
- Congressional Schedule
- House Judiciary Committee
- Homeland Security
- Budget Committee
- Ways and Means
- Foreign Affairs Committee

## Live Floor Activity & Legislative Tracking

- [Live House Floor Dashboard](https://live.house.gov): Real-time dashboard for U.S. House of Representatives floor activity and legislative tracking

## Committee Hearings & Oversight

- [Oversight of the Office of Special Counsel Jack Smith](https://judiciary.house.gov/committee-activity/hearings/oversight-office-special-counsel-jack-smith): House Judiciary Committee hearing on oversight of Special Counsel Jack Smith's office
- [When Public Funds Are Abused: Addressing Fraud and the Theft of Taxpayer Dollars](https://judiciary.house.gov/committee-activity/hearings/when-public-funds-are-abused-addressing-fraud-and-theft-taxpayer): House Judiciary Committee hearing on public funds fraud and taxpayer dollar theft
- [Embedded Threats: Foreign Ownership, Hidden Hardware, and Licensing Failures in America's Transportation Systems](https://judiciary.house.gov/committee-activity/hearings/embedded-threats-foreign-ownership-hidden-hardware-and-licensing): House Judiciary hearing on foreign ownership and security threats in transportation systems
- [Oversight of the Department of Homeland Security: CISA, TSA, S&T](https://homeland.house.gov/hearing/oversight-of-the-department-of-homeland-security-cisa-tsa-st): Congressional hearing on DHS oversight including CISA, TSA, and cybersecurity agencies
- [Smarter Borders, Safer Nation: Expanding the Use of Non-Intrusive Inspection Technology](https://homeland.house.gov/hearing/smarter-borders-safer-nation-expanding-the-use-of-non-intrusive-inspection-technology): Homeland Security hearing on border inspection technology and customs enforcement
- [Hearing on Reverse the Curse: Skyrocketing Health Care Costs and America's Fiscal Future](https://budget.house.gov/hearing/hearing-notice-reverse-the-curse-skyrocketing-health-care-costs-and-americas-fiscal-future): House Budget Committee hearing on healthcare costs and America's fiscal future
- [Work & Welfare Subcommittee Hearing on Strengthening the Child Support Enforcement Program](https://waysandmeans.house.gov/event/work-welfare-subcommittee-hearing-on-strengthening-the-child-support-enforcement-program-status-challenges-and-opportunities-for-modernization): Ways and Means subcommittee hearing on child support enforcement modernization

## Committee Markups & Legislation

- [Various Measures](https://foreignaffairs.house.gov/committee-activity/markups/various-measures-30): Foreign Affairs Committee markup on export controls, AI, and diplomatic security measures

## Committee Meetings & Announcements

- [Meeting Announcement For January 20, 2026](https://rules.house.gov/media/announcement/meeting-announcement-january-20-2026): Committee on Rules meeting announcement for January 20, 2026 on legislative measures
- [Meeting Announcement For January 21, 2026](https://rules.house.gov/media/announcement/meeting-announcement-january-21-2026): Committee on Rules meeting announcement for appropriations bills on January 21, 2026
